verdict.rationale: Uploading custom weights is directly documented (`hf upload username/my-cool-model ./model.safetensors`). The homepage says models can be deployed on Inference Endpoints 'in a few clicks', and Inference Providers mention LoRA support for image and video generation. However, the evidence never explicitly shows an uploaded custom model or LoRA adapter being served. Missing for 10: explicit docs on deploying user-uploaded weights to Inference Endpoints, LoRA adapter serving for LLMs, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end upload-to-serve flow.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: Deploy on optimized [Inference Endpoints](/pricing#endpoints) or update your [Spaces applications](/pricing#spaces) to a GPU in a few clicks.
